about: Synthetic question set for Ask femio's trusted-source registry (2026-11-24). Written by the lead session from the persona specs in docs/personas, not collected from real users. 'expect' lists English stems; a returned passage whose title or text contains any of them (every part of an 'a+b' item) counts as a strong answer. Group 'rules' must be stopped by the safety rules or never reach a verdict. Read by test/registry_coverage_test.dart. 'alsoAccept' lists passage ids the lead session read and judged to answer the question although they lack the stem (hand grading, R7.14).
